# What a ROS 2 type support can be asked about

`rosidl` 3.1.6 expresses **154 of the corpus's 421 cases**. The 267 it cannot are grouped below by the construct that stops them.

2 of those never reach a model at all: the IDL front end refuses the file, and the case exists to record that every implementation must. `recursive-array`, `resolve-module-named-as-type`.

## Why the rest cannot be expressed

| cases | the construct with no `rosidl` form |
|---|---|
| 53 | a union, which rosidl's IDL grammar has no `union` keyword for |
| 36 | a @mutable type, whose member headers rosidl parses and then does not write |
| 33 | a map, which rosidl's IDL grammar has no `map` keyword for |
| 30 | an enumeration, which rosidl's type model does not have — its IDL parses `enum` and then reports the name as unknown |
| 21 | a bitmask, which rosidl's IDL grammar has no `bitmask` keyword for |
| 17 | a multi-dimensional array, which rosidl's IDL parser refuses by name |
| 12 | a bitset, which rosidl's IDL grammar has no `bitset` keyword for |
| 10 | a fixed, which rosidl's IDL grammar has no `fixed` keyword for |
| 8 | an @optional member, for which rosidl has no presence marker |
| 7 | a sequence whose element is itself a collection, which rosidl has no shape for |
| 7 | a struct with a base, which rosidl's IDL grammar has no syntax for |
| 7 | a top-level type that is not a struct, and a rosidl message is always a struct |
| 5 | a long double, whose rosidl holder is the C compiler's and not the binary128 Table 31 names |
| 3 | a member named by a C or C++ keyword, which rosidl_generator_c spells verbatim in a header its fastrtps type support compiles as C++ |
| 3 | a recursive type, for which §7.4.1.1 gives no encoding to compare against |
| 3 | an array whose element is itself a collection, which rosidl has no shape for |
| 2 | a struct with no members, which rosidl's IDL grammar refuses |
